name: ablation_dev_free
description: The ablation grid A0-A9 on the development set for the Groq FREE plan (about 200K tokens per day per model, Settings > Limits in the Groq console): the same as ablation_template.json, with 1 repeat instead of 3 for the three rows with five samples and a two-step planner (A5, A6, A7), which cost about three times the tokens of the others. Same tags and run folders as the template. A5 to A7 are then single runs: their cells have no SD, and Table 4 says so. Use it only while the quota is the limit; with a paid plan use the template.

rows.label: B1: one LLM call, whole-route replacement
B0: five samples, whole-route replacement (v1 default)
A2 + two-step planner, with Route Builder hint
Better of A3 and A4 + multi-candidate selection
rows.note: decide: this takes A3 (with hint). If A4 is better, use "n5_r1_s3+ts" and parent "A4"; decide on the development set, before the sealed set.

rows.label: A5 + retrieval-based few-shot
rows.note: decide: k = 2 retrieved examples (fs2); fs4 is the other choice. Examples come only from the development data.

rows.label: A6 + extended verifier (feasibility rules)
rows.note: decide: fz2 = hard findings and risk insertions; fz1 = hard findings only. fz does not change the prompt, so it costs no new sample calls.

rows.label: A7 + model cascade (optional)
rows.note: optional. The cascade chooses its own models (small gpt-oss-20b, then large gpt-oss-120b), so it is the same run in every column and A8 vs A7 mixes the effect of the cascade with a change of model: read it with scripts/cascade_pareto.py (validity against cost).

rows.label: Constrained planner (optional)
rows.note: optional, WP10 (RQ5). Same five samples and the same selection as A2 (b0_r1), but each sample is built step by step under the precedence graph (+cg1), so nothing needs repair: paired with A2 it answers 'repair after generation or constraint during generation'. It cannot add an operation the Route Builder's set lacks, so read it with the flags and M4, not validity alone. Calls: about 2 per sample on the development set, not one per step, because most steps have a single option. For a comparison with the full pipeline add a row n5_r0_s3+cg1 next to A5.
